rules: R-15, and its 2026-08-14 amendment: a membership transition that is the ruled consequence of a declared change is adjudicated by citation, not by verdict.
R-17/R-32: no baseline moves in this commit; the slice lands against the committed coupled baseline plus this allowlist.
R-36: an allowlist is slice-local and moves with the commit that moves the paths it claims.
what_this_allowlist_is_for: This slice changes no calculator behaviour at all. It changes how scripts/golden_snapshot.py::leaf_report PAIRS list members: a list every member of which carries an event_id is paired by that identity -- the event's origin id plus that origin's ordinal -- and never by list position. Three coupled leaf paths are spelled for the first time as a result, and this receipt claims them. Nothing about the tree moved: the same two event rows and the same one support row are removed by the same landed corrections as before, and the same owner field is absent for the same ruled reason. What changed is that the report now says so as a membership transition instead of as a run of value diffs against whichever record the ordinal shift slid into its place.

instrument_change.was: _leaf_diffs paired list members by index, so a slice that removed an earlier member re-labelled every later one: old events[82] (event_id main:enemy:Aatrox:33) was compared against new events[82] (event_id main:enemy:Aatrox:35), two different events, producing six manufactured field diffs and hiding the removal.
instrument_change.now: _identity_keyed_diffs pairs by event_id. A member both sides hold keeps the BASELINE's ordinal in its path, which is the address every committed allowlist, receipt and escalation ledger already spells. A member only one side holds is one value_to_absent / absent_to_value membership transition. A list with a duplicate or a missing identity falls back to positional pairing, whole, never half by identity and half by position.
instrument_change.identity_carried_on_the_diff: LeafDiff gains `identity`, so a report and the investigator brief built from it name WHICH event a leaf belongs to rather than only which ordinal the baseline stored it at.

landed_against.rule: R-17/R-32/D-97 -- no baseline moves inside this commit

qualifying_population.enumerated_from: scripts/golden_coupled_baseline.json (committed) and the pre-change compare report, by taking the event_id set of every identity-bearing list section in every coupled scenario on both sides and differencing them.
qualifying_population.rule: Only a list section whose event_id set differs between the two sides can be re-spelled: where the id sets are equal, identity pairing and positional pairing agree member for member, so those sections cannot contribute a path. The enumeration is therefore total over the committed baseline and bounds what may qualify.
sections_examined: combat/events, combat/healing_events and combat/support_events in all thirteen coupled scenarios -- the three list sections whose members carry event_id

predicted.why_three_and_not_two: Two removed event rows are two membership transitions, but one of them (events[83], main:enemy:Aatrox:34) is already claimed at that exact ordinal by expected-golden-diff-P4-S7-bloodsong.json, so only events[82] is newly spelled. The support list contributes its removed record and, on the record the removal was previously being compared against, the one field that really did move.

measured.differing_leaves: 145 before, 124 after -- the same tree, 21 fewer manufactured diffs

oracle_receipts.rule: R-15's 2026-08-14 amendment. Every leaf below is a membership transition that is the ruled consequence of a declared change, so it is adjudicated by the citation in its own row and no oracle receipt is owed on it. Both guards hold for all three: the transition is value_to_absent as the identity-keyed leaf_report classifies it -- not a value re-spelled as a removal by an ordinal shift -- and each cited ruling is one a reader can open.

leaves.ruling: The Phase 4 S7 Bloodsong authority move -- bloodsong.expose_weakness from SPLIT to COUPLED_AUTHORITATIVE_WITH_PAIR_PREVIEW, ruled by the umbrella's Amendment D and landed with docs/receipts/expected-golden-diff-P4-S7-bloodsong.json. That receipt already claims this removal; it claims it at the ordinals the positional report spelled (events[83] and events[84]), because two removed members were reported as a change at [82], a removal at [83] and a removal at [84]. Identity pairing spells the same two removals at the ordinals the BASELINE holds them at, [82] and [83], and reports the survivor -- main:enemy:Aatrox:35, at baseline ordinal [84] -- as unchanged, which it is, field for field.
leaves.why_no_oracle_receipt_is_owed: The row is a zero-damage skipped_reason=attacker_dead row the pair preview authored and the coupled walk no longer does. Its absence is what the authority move says, not a number cached wiki text can decide; docs/receipts/oracle-S6S7-leaf10.json and oracle-S6S7-leaf30.json are what happens when it is asked as a value question anyway.
leaves.reclassifies: docs/receipts/oracle-P4C-C3-s6s7-events-82-ordinal-reindexed-record-leaf1.json and -leaf2.json, and through them oracle-S6S7-leaf10.json and oracle-S6S7-leaf30.json -- the C3 cluster, whose leaf paths events[82]/damage_type and events[82]/sequence this re-spelling retires. The classification receipts that supersede them are filed in this slice group's next commit.

leaves.ruling: One arming of Black Cleaver -- Carve on one subject by one holder. The Phase 4 S7 rearm correction (D-13/D-62/D-66/D-92, docs/receipts/expected-golden-diff-P4-S7-rearm.json) folds a repeated arming of ONE holder's mechanic on ONE subject into the live modifier the first arming opened, so the second Carve row at the same fraction is not authored. The fold is certified new_value_correct by the P4C whole-series pass, docs/receipts/oracle-P4C-C1-carve-rearm-series-cleaver-bloodsong-leaf1.json through -leaf11.json.
leaves.why_no_oracle_receipt_is_owed: The absence is the fold. Which of the two landed S7 corrections authored this particular row's disappearance is not re-attributed here and is not this receipt's to rule; expected-golden-diff-P4-S7-bloodsong.json claims the leaves the positional report spelled at these ordinals, and no committed claim is withdrawn by a re-spelling.

leaves.ruling: D-07: every packet modifying another participant's damage declares an Authority, and `owner` is present IFF Authority == SPLIT. The S7 Bloodsong authority move takes bloodsong.expose_weakness off SPLIT, so its packets carry no owner. The same drop is already claimed at two sibling records by expected-golden-diff-P4-S7-bloodsong.json -- support_events[5]/owner and support_events[12]/owner, the two Expose Weakness armings whose ordinals no removal shifted. This is the third arming, enemy:Aatrox:support:2, which the positional report could not show as itself because the removal above pushed it one place.
leaves.why_no_oracle_receipt_is_owed: A packet's owner is a provenance field whose presence a decision rules and whose absence no cached wiki text can adjudicate. docs/receipts/oracle-S6S7-leaf24.json is that question asked as a value question, and escalated-defects-S6S7-oracle.json's third entry already records that its dissent means 'no evidence exists' rather than 'the tree is wrong'.
leaves.reclassifies: docs/receipts/oracle-S6S7-leaf24.json -- the C4 dissent, filed against this same owner drop at the ordinal the positional report gave it (support_events[17]/owner). The classification receipt that supersedes it is filed in this slice group's next commit.

paths_this_re_spelling_retires.why_recorded: A path that stops being spelled is a claim that stops being exercised, and the receipts claiming these paths are NOT edited (R-19's supersession discipline: a committed claim stands even when the instrument stops producing it). Recorded here so a reader of expected-golden-diff-P4-S7-bloodsong.json can see why its events[82] field leaves and its support_events[17] field leaves no longer appear in the compare.
